svg.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 15 nodes and 20 edges. organized in 5 groups. flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: omp event tool_call / tool_result / before_agent_start / session_stop, jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch, state builder allowlisted fields, size cap, no raw transcript.. Key relationships: omp event tool_call / tool_result / before_agent_start / session_stop points to jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch; jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch points to state builder allowlisted fields, size cap, no raw transcript; state builder allowlisted fields, size cap, no raw transcript points to L0 rule / regex / lookup ~0 ms, $0.. Layout spans 1405 by 3014 units with 15 rendered node boxes and 20 routed edge paths.
svg.text: cascade: cheapest first, stop at the first confident layer
outcome labels from the fleet logs

g.title: omp event tool_call / tool_result / before_agent_start / session_stop points to jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch
jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch points to state builder allowlisted fields, size cap, no raw transcript
state builder allowlisted fields, size cap, no raw transcript points to L0 rule / regex / lookup ~0 ms, $0
L0 rule / regex / lookup ~0 ms, $0 points to calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set with label: decided
L0 rule / regex / lookup ~0 ms, $0 points to L1 embedding + linear probe Qwen3-0.6B / bge, ms, $0 with label: unsure
L1 embedding + linear probe Qwen3-0.6B / bge, ms, $0 points to calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set with label: confident
L1 embedding + linear probe Qwen3-0.6B / bge, ms, $0 points to L2 encoder classifier DeBERTa / MiniCheck / NLI, 10-100 ms, $0 with label: unsure
L2 encoder classifier DeBERTa / MiniCheck / NLI, 10-100 ms, $0 points to calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set with label: confident
L2 encoder classifier DeBERTa / MiniCheck / NLI, 10-100 ms, $0 points to L3 typed model Clef local via localbench gateway, 3-4 s or Jev hosted, 0.2-1 s, paid with label: unsure or no encoder
L3 typed model Clef local via localbench gateway, 3-4 s or Jev hosted, 0.2-1 s, paid points to calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set
L4 LLM judge comparison arm only optionally points to calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set with label: offline bake-off only
calibration + threshold same Platt for every backend, NP or cost cut, abstain set points to action on the safe side keep / allow / annotate / route / drop
action on the safe side keep / allow / annotate / route / drop points to decision log ~/.local/state/jev backend, latency, cost, hash, never text
jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch points to action on the safe side keep / allow / annotate / route / drop with label: timeout / no key / cap
decision log ~/.local/state/jev backend, latency, cost, hash, never text points to read-back, re-read, error, revert, user correction
read-back, re-read, error, revert, user correction points to conformance C1-C7 + goldens harness bead with label: fixtures + goldens
read-back, re-read, error, revert, user correction points to value ledger KEEP / KILL jev-mvvh, VALUE2 jev-ktrx with label: rows
conformance C1-C7 + goldens harness bead points to L3 live both ways jev-grzn
L3 live both ways jev-grzn points to value ledger KEEP / KILL jev-mvvh, VALUE2 jev-ktrx
value ledger KEEP / KILL jev-mvvh, VALUE2 jev-ktrx points to jev hook or extension latency budget, fail-open, off switch with label: KILL switches the surface off
